sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; GRAFT was first-choice but current remote data already contained it, so the dated non-duplicate roadmap was selected.
The complete official roadmap page was read, including October 19 updates, goals, acceptance thresholds, and stated expectations.
The writeup separates company-reported progress from independently verifiable results and records missing protocols, redactions, and non-generalization boundaries.
Chinese analysis exceeds 5,000 Han characters and uses structured sections, tables, formulas, and Mermaid without nonessential images.
